thread:
Priya K: Quick sync — we're preparing a percent+region canary for model v12. I want a short ops checklist and an agreed ramp cadence before I flip the initial slice.
Alex R: Where will the flags live? I can update the feature-flag store and push the rollout.
Priya K: Flag names: model.v12.canary (global percent), model.v12.region_slices (per-region map), model.v12.kill_switch. We'll keep kill_switch ready.
Jordan M: For quality gating, can we route 100% of low-confidence preds to v11 fallback? Need to avoid regressions.
Maya S: Yes — add routing policy: "fallback_on_confidence < 0.7 -> v11". Also, we'll want latency and error-rate alerts at +20% baseline.
Sam (oncall): Recommend starting at 0.5% in us-east, then 1% eu-west, then 1% apac. Pause points every 30m. If p95 latency > 200ms or error-rate delta > 3% for >2m, hit the kill_switch and page.
Alex R: I'll stage the flag JSON in the store. Example config I'm going to push:
```json
{
  "model.v12.canary": 0.005,
  "model.v12.region_slices": {"us-east": 0.005, "eu-west": 0.0, "apac": 0.0},
  "model.v12.kill_switch": false
}
```
Priya K: That looks right. We'll do incremental percent increases: 0.5% -> 1% -> 5% -> 10% over ~6 hours if signals ok. Region order: us-east, eu-west, apac.
Jordan M: On the model side, I'll enable KV-cache warmup and set a shorter seq_len limiter for canary traffic to reduce p99 spikes. Also tagging requests with header X-Canary-Model: v12 so telemetry can filter.
Maya S: I'll create a dashboard with these panels: p95 latency by region, request success rate, model confidence distribution, token per-request cost. Alert runbook: slack -> oncall -> rollback.
Alex R: Command I'll run after we agree (feature-flag service):
```
curl -X POST https://flags.redwood.internal/api/v1/set -H 'Authorization: Bearer $FF_TOKEN' -d '{"key":"model.v12.region_slices","value":{"us-east":0.005}}'
```
Sam (oncall): If any automated QA test fails or if eval regressions > 1% on our smoke prompts, kill_switch = true and I page infra.
Priya K: Sounds good. Quick ask: can someone sanity-check the rollout window? I'm planning start at 08:30 UTC tomorrow to catch APAC off-hours.
Maya S: 08:30 UTC works for us — gives SRE overlap. I'll be watching the dashboard.
Jordan M: I'll have a small eval job running and post metrics in this thread every checkpoint.
Alex R: Pushing initial 0.5% to us-east in 15m. Deploy-bot: please post a confirmation once feature flags update.
deploy-bot: feature-flags-service: model.v12.region_slices updated {us-east:0.005} by Alex R at 2456789220 :white_check_mark:
Priya K: :thumbsup: thanks all. If anything noisy, hit model.v12.kill_switch = true and ping @oncall. I'll post the rollout timeline once Alex confirms initial flip.
Sam (oncall): Acknowledged. I'll put the escalation page in the incident channel with the exact thresholds.
Jordan M: Posting first eval snapshot in 30m.
Alex R: Initial slice applied and traffic is flowing. No immediate errors in logs.
Priya K: Great — leaving notes here as we go.
